notes.title: Tutorial Integration
notes.content:
The tutorial is now integrated into your first run. Instead of a standalone tutorial with a lot of information at once you will now get some information about the game in each fight. This should help new players get started a lot quicker.

Patchnotes
[list]
[*] Integrated tutorial into normal game flow.
[*] Nari's passive now works on all Attack cards, no matter if you dealt damage with them or not.
[*] Fixed the animation for gaining and losing block.
[*] Various small bug fixes.
[/list]
